title: MolHop: Scaffold-Hopping Molecular Design with Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19920v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Molecular design is often formulated as an optimization problem over existing molecular spaces. However, molecular optimization and the discovery of structurally distinct replacement molecules represent two fundamentally different search problems. LLM-based molecular design agents typically perform the former, conducting local refinement within the neighborhood of existing structures to improve target properties through structural modifications. In contrast, the latter requires exploration of a broader chemical space to discover molecules with entirely different scaffolds while preserving the functional characteristics of reference molecules. We propose MolHop, an agentic framework for cross-scaffold molecular discovery that enables models to navigate and edit within a pre-organized chemical space. MolHop organizes approximately 1.6 million molecular scaffolds from commercial molecules into a coarse-to-fine hierarchical action space. T

translated_title: MolHop：基于智能体强化学习的骨架跃迁分子设计
translated_abstract: 分子设计通常被表述为在现有分子空间上的优化问题。然而，分子优化与发现结构上截然不同的替代分子代表了两个本质不同的搜索问题。基于大语言模型（LLM）的分子设计智能体通常执行前者，即在现有结构的邻域内进行局部细化，通过结构修饰来改善目标性质。相比之下，后者需要探索更广泛的化学空间，以发现具有完全不同骨架同时保留参考分子功能特性的分子。我们提出了 MolHop，一个用于跨骨架分子发现的智能体框架，使模型能够在预先组织好的化学空间中进行导航和编辑。MolHop 将来自商业分子的约 160 万个分子骨架组织成一个从粗到细的分层动作空间。
tldr: MolHop 提出了一个基于智能体强化学习的跨骨架分子发现框架，将约 160 万个商业分子骨架组织成从粗到细的分层动作空间，使模型能够发现骨架完全不同但保留参考分子功能特性的新分子。
en_tdlr: MolHop is an agentic reinforcement learning framework for scaffold-hopping molecular discovery that organizes approximately 1.6 million molecular scaffolds into a coarse-to-fine hierarchical action space, enabling models to navigate chemical space and discover structurally distinct molecules while preserving the functional characteristics of reference molecules.
